AUTOCAPTIONS
Local Engine Setup
▼
Autocaptions runs locally using Python, Whisper, and MoviePy. No data leaves your machine.
⚠️ Note on resources: Installing dependencies compiles large ML libraries. On low-end systems, this will lag your PC or temporarily freeze After Effects. Please leave your PC idle until it finishes. We automatically set process priority to lowest to mitigate this.
